title: Scenario D - carry squeeze
description: No price shock: rates over horizon_days (simple interest). Loss vs today's net equity; a positive carry is a negative loss. comparison: same horizon at the snapshot's rates.

susde_apy.description: sUSDe staking APY over the horizon, e.g. 0 when funding turns negative; negative = exchange rate falls (reserve fund spent).

borrow_apy_override.description: Borrow APY on all debt, e.g. 0.60 at a utilization kink; null = snapshot per position.

collateral_supply_apy_override.description: Lending supply APY on all collateral; null = snapshot per position. sUSDe collateral also accrues through its exchange rate.

pt_implied_apy_shock.description: Additive change of PT implied APY at the horizon.
